package rulefixtures

import "strings"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_string_handling_string_lower_for_case_insensitive_compare: Layer: String handling. Flag lowercasing both sides for case-insensitive compare in hot paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario572Positive(a string, b string) bool {
	return strings.ToLower(a) == strings.ToLower(b)
}
